subject: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO checklist & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintechco.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-10T15:02:00-07:00
Subject: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO checklist & next steps

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Per our demo and perf discussion, I wanted to capture the agreed performance targets and proposed next steps so we can align the POC scope. Please confirm if anything below should be adjusted.

Performance targets (requested by FintechCo):
- P95 latency (text generation, avg prompt size ~120 tokens): <= 200ms
- Sustained throughput: ~500 requests/sec across the service (bursty traffic expected during batch jobs)
- Concurrency: support 50 concurrent user sessions with streaming responses enabled
- Streaming: chunked token streaming to clients with max single-stream latency <= 50ms per chunk
- Availability target: 99.9% (SLA to be discussed in contract phase)

Notes / constraints you mentioned:
- Models should run in our US region with data residency in AWS us-east-1
- Some requests will include multimodal embeddings later in the Q4 roadmap

Proposed MAP (mutual action plan) items:
1) Redwood: share SLO checklist + perf-test plan (attached) — by EOD tomorrow
2) FintechCo: confirm sample workloads and representative request traces (anonymized) — by COB Fri
3) Joint: schedule an isolated perf run (staging cluster) — next available Wed 8/11 or Thu 8/12
4) Redwood: provide estimated cost per 1M tokens at preferred config + recommended quantization profile — within 3 business days

Decision criteria you flagged: latency & p95 under load, predictable unit cost, and smooth streaming experience. If we hit P95 <=200ms under your representative traffic and keep cost within your target, you indicated a green light to move to a 6-week POC.

Next steps I suggest: confirm Wed 8/11 10:00am PT for the perf run and send over a small sample of traces (where possible) today.

Attachment: fintechco-slo-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 34KB)

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: FintechCo Engineering <ops@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-08-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO checklist & next steps

Marissa —

Thanks for the concise summary, this is exactly what we needed. A few clarifications and confirmations from our side:

- Targets: P95 <=200ms and 500 req/s look right; we may need to accept short 5-10 minute warm-up periods during cold starts but the POC should demonstrate steady-state behavior.
- Concurrency/Streaming: we need streaming for real-time UX. Critical that per-chunk latency stays low — 50ms per chunk is our target. If you have examples of chunk sizes you recommend, please include.
- Throughput: during batch reconciliation windows we could spike to ~800 req/s for short windows (5-10 mins). Will that degrade P95 below threshold? Please advise on recommended autoscaling/burst config.

We can provide anonymized traces — I’ll send a sanitized sample to ops@redwood.com by EOD. Wed 8/11 10:00am PT works for us for the perf run; please confirm the staging cluster endpoint and any auth keys.

Decision criteria: in addition to perf, our procurement team will evaluate cost per 1M tokens and security posture (SOC2 + data residency). We’ll likely request a short security questionnaire during the contracting phase.

Looking forward to the perf test.

—Alex
Alex Turner
CTO, FintechCo
alex.turner@fintechco.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@fintechco.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-12T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FintechCo — Post-demo performance SLO checklist & next steps

Alex — thanks for the quick reply and for confirming Wed at 10:00am PT. A few operational details to prepare: 

1) Staging endpoint & auth: we’ll share a short-lived API key and a staging endpoint (us-east-1) 24 hours before the run. Look for a separate email from infra@redwood.com.
2) Chunk sizing: for streaming we recommend chunks of ~32-64 tokens (typical), which should keep per-chunk latency <50ms on our average config. If your client needs smaller chunks we can test 16-token chunks during the run.
3) Bursty throughput: our autoscaling + warm pool config can handle spikes to ~800 req/s for short windows if you provision a small burst capacity — we’ll include recommended pool sizes in the perf plan. Expect some p95 widening during spikes unless a larger warm pool is reserved.
4) Security docs: attaching the SLO checklist; SOC2 + evidence & security questionnaire answers can be provided via the secure link in the MAP doc (shared to your procurement lead).

Attached: fintechco-slo-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 34KB)
Related HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/FIN-2027-092

MAP updated:
- Redwood: perf test run + summary report (post-run) — owner: Marissa — ETA: 8/12 EOD
- FintechCo: traces + procurement contact — owner: Alex — ETA: 8/11 COB

If that all looks good I’ll send the staging details tomorrow morning and open the perf-run calendar invite.

Best,
Marissa
